summary:
ASTRONURSE 360 is an AI-assisted educational healthcare platform designed to explore astronaut health monitoring and nursing support during space missions. It combines a simulated health monitoring dashboard, AI-powered educational nursing assistance, early warning demonstrations, and access to NASA's official space science research and data resources.
The platform aims to connect nursing knowledge, artificial intelligence, and space research to demonstrate how healthcare concepts can support future human space exploration. It also highlights how space-health research can inspire healthcare innovation on Earth.
details:
ASTRONURSE 360 – Innovating Healthcare Beyond Earth

Introduction

Human space exploration presents unique healthcare challenges. Astronauts may experience physiological changes associated with microgravity, sleep disruption, stress, cardiovascular adaptation, and limited access to immediate medical assistance.

ASTRONURSE 360 is an AI-assisted educational prototype that explores how digital health monitoring, nursing knowledge, and NASA research resources can contribute to understanding astronaut healthcare.

Our Proposed Solution

The platform brings together several features:

1. AI Health Monitoring Dashboard Displays demonstration health indicators such as heart rate, oxygen saturation (SpO2), body temperature, sleep information, and stress indicators. Demonstration values are simulated and are not collected from real astronauts.

2. Early Warning Demonstration Shows configurable demonstration alerts when simulated readings cross selected thresholds. These alerts illustrate a possible monitoring workflow and do not provide medical diagnoses.

3. AI Nursing Assistant Provides educational explanations of nursing concepts, astronaut health topics, and relevant space-health research in accessible language.

4. NASA Data Explorer Provides access to official NASA research and public data resources, including NASA Science News, NASA Open Science Data Repository, NASA Earthdata, and NASA APIs.

5. Space Health Education Helps nursing students and other learners explore the relationship between nursing, space medicine, human physiology, and future space exploration.

Innovation

ASTRONURSE 360 combines nursing education, AI-assisted explanations, simulated health monitoring, and NASA research discovery in one accessible platform.

It aims to make space-health topics easier to understand and demonstrate how nursing knowledge can contribute to future healthcare innovation.

Impact

The project has potential educational value for nursing students, healthcare learners, and people interested in human space exploration. It also encourages students in Pakistan and other communities to participate in interdisciplinary space science innovation.

Limitations and Safety

ASTRONURSE 360 is an educational prototype, not a certified medical device. Its demonstration health readings are simulated. AI-generated explanations may contain errors and must not replace qualified medical professionals, clinical assessment, or medical advice.

Real-world clinical use would require validated sensors, scientific testing, clinical supervision, and relevant regulatory approval.

Future Development

Future improvements may include validated wearable sensor integration, expanded NASA research resources, improved health data visualization, and further development of educational AI assistance.
